one_liner: Joel Embiid's scoring rate is 33.3 points per 36 minutes, but he appears in only 93 games across the three-season window.
three_things: When on the floor he is dominant: 33.3 points and 10.3 rebounds per 36 minutes.
Availability is the headline caveat -- just 93 games and 2,977.5 minutes over three seasons.
He shoots a guard-like 87.4 percent from the free-throw line for a center.
context_note: Numbers are per-36-minute rates over a 3-season sample (seasons_played: 3), not per-game and not a full career; the manifest is descriptive_only, with no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor. The 93-game count means the rate line rests on a smaller sample than most stars here, and per-36 rates do not reflect missed availability.
